title: Unary extension of a list function
statement: Given a function $g$ from natural numbers to Boolean lists, define its extension to Boolean lists by sending a list $x$ to $g(|x|)$ when every entry of $x$ is true, and to the empty list otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A function from natural numbers to Boolean lists
